what: the corpus lane's lists for the names gate, each kept here byte for byte in the folder the lane keeps it in. Since ship 20 (23 November 2026) the rows of relay v213 (the rows relays v200, v201 and v202 landed) and of relay v219 (the translation tables' rows) are marked beside names v2's (more_name_rows), and the list of places is names v1's with relay v219's addition laid on it (place_names.additions). The served rows whose every entry its own source marks as a name are names v2's (relay v198: every dictionary that marks a name, by its own mark; it takes the place of names v1's list of rows). The word places of the thirty-nine books that are a name stay names v1's (relay v177), as the lane's letter says. tools/apply-name-rows-v1.mjs marks the rows; tools/project-lattice-v12-v1.mjs marks the places on each word

additions.what: the corpus lane's addition to names v1's list of places (relay v219, section 1). Names v1 read TAHOT on the lines word numbering v1 tied to each place, and at 7 places of the spelling bridge that numbering tied none, so names v1 never read TAHOT there; numbering v1.1 finds the line, and TAHOT's own grammar there marks a name. 1 place is ADDED, Ezekiel 27:6 word 11 («Kittim»), which neither witness named, put in between the two lines of names v1 its `beside` names; at 6 places names v1 lists by MACULA alone, TAHOT is WITNESS_ADDED and the place takes the `by` the addition gives. Laid on names v1's list wherever the list is read (tools/name-lists-v1.mjs); names v1's file is not rewritten. Laid with relay v213's marks, as the lane's call says, so that no row is held back at a place it was landed for (ship 20, 23 November 2026)

superseded.what: names v1's list of name rows, which names v2's takes the place of: 7,377 of its 7,412 rows are in names v2's list, and 35 leave it, all the UBS dictionary's, whose base form names a name and another part of speech at once (names v2 reads such an entry as partly a name, and the rows stand). Kept in the lane's folder beside the list of places; no tool reads it

not_kept_here: names v2's four other lists stay on the lane's store (r2:mishkan/v2/ledgers/all/names/names-v2/): the rows partly a name (3,345), the rows its source marks a people's name (829), the rows of another mark or none (8,891) and the common words (526,847; 32.6 MB). Nothing on a card reads them; each is named with its sha256 in the lane's receipt kept here

addendum.what: the 26 served rows names v1 counted and did not list: 22 whose own source gives part of them as a name and part not, 4 that its reading of the sources did not reach. None is a name row: tools/apply-name-rows-v1.mjs never reads this list and no row of it carries the mark, which tools/check-names-gate-v1.mjs holds (N7). It is the list of rows a gate asked the other way would have to leave alone
addendum.note: each sha256 is the one the letter names for the file (its lines 69, 74 and 75), and the bytes taken hash to it; the rule is the relay's one RULE.md for all its answers, of which section 2 is this list's

more_name_rows.what: the rows relays v200, v201 and v202 landed whose every entry its own source marks a name, read by names v2's rule unchanged (relay v213): 22 rows, v200's 18 and v202's 4, every one TAHOT's (M4), a name by TAHOT's own grammar on the line its record names. Laid with names v2's by tools/apply-name-rows-v1.mjs. Held from ship 15 until the place list's question was answered (relay v219), so that the line at Ezekiel 27:6 word 11 moves once: laid with the addition to the places (ship 20, 23 November 2026)

join.why: each line names its row as names v2's lines do, at the rank it was served at in the store the lane's receipt names (inputs.route_store.store_version), and is followed from there through the row-strikes record

more_name_rows.not_kept_here: the relay's other lists stay on the lane's store (r2:mishkan/v2/ledgers/all/names/names-landed-v1/): the common-word rows (1,446), the other rows (2), the rows with no rule yet (22,259; 8.3 MB), the two empty lists, the answer, the builder and the second count. Nothing on a card reads them, and the receipt kept here names each by its sha256

more_name_rows.what: the translation tables' rows (M78, M103) whose English entry's own part of speech is a name, read by a reader of their own (relay v219, section 5): 6 rows of the 126 table lines relay v210 keeps («Tigris», «Lebanon», «Lord» twice, «Christ», «April»), whose lines ships 16 and 18 landed. Laid with names v2's by tools/apply-name-rows-v1.mjs (ship 20, 23 November 2026)

join.why: the letter: «lay `name: 1` on each row they name, joined by `k`, `m` and `sha` (the route's)». The lane read no served store for these lines, so a line names no rank to follow: its row is found by key, m id and sha16 in the store as it stands, exactly one row, or nothing is written

not_laid.why: STEP's expanded Strong (M51), 832 rows: their lines are lines of relay v207's Bible dictionaries list, which have not landed and are held for the owner's word (relay v219, section 6). When they land, their rows are laid the same way. Kept on the lane's store and not here

more_name_rows.not_kept_here: the relay's other files stay on the lane's store (r2:mishkan/v2/ledgers/all/names/places-at-bridge-v1/): the bridge places read (1,173 lines), M51's two lists, the tables' common-word rows (120), the empty lists, the answer, the builder, the second count and the checker's recount. Nothing on a card reads them, and the receipt kept here names each by its sha256
